verdict.rationale: v0 documents that several chats can connect to one Project and share its deployment, hosting, domains and environment variables, and the pricing docs show team accounts with a shared credit pool. GitHub branching supports parallel work on one codebase. The evidence never explicitly says that multiple team members can open and edit the same project in a shared team workspace. missing for 10: explicit documentation of a team workspace with multi-member access to the same project, member roles/permissions, real-time or concurrent collaboration details, independent hands-on corroboration of team collaboration.

support.subject: As a founder, my team can work on the same project together in a shared workspace

citations.quote: You can connect multiple chats to the same Project. This is useful when working different parts of one Project
One Project shares deployment, hosting, domains, and environment variables for the chats connected to it.
